arxiv-2106-09485.title: Secure Multi-Function Computation with Private Remote Sources
arxiv-2106-09485.creator: Onur Günlü, , Matthieu Bloch, , and Rafael F. Schaefer
arxiv-2106-09485.description: Abstract We consider a distributed function computation problem in which parties observing noisy versions of a remote source facilitate the computation of a function of their observations at a fusion center through public communication. The distributed function computation is subject to constraints, including not only reliability and storage but also privacy and secrecy. Specifically, 1.

arxiv-2307-08135.title: Open intervals in sums and products of Cantor sets.
arxiv-2307-08135.creator: Aritro Pathak
arxiv-2307-08135.description: Abstract We give new arguments for sums and products of sufficient numbers of arbitrary central Cantor sets to produce large open intervals. We further discuss the same question for C 1 C^{1} images of such central Cantor sets. This gives another perspective on the results obtained by Astels through a different formulation on the thickness of these Cantor sets.

arxiv-2311-05744.title: Flexibility of Integrated Power and Gas Systems: Gas Flow Modeling and Solution Choices Matter
arxiv-2311-05744.creator: Enrica Raheli, Yannick Werner, Jalal Kazempour
arxiv-2311-05744.description: Abstract Due to their slow gas flow dynamics, natural gas pipelines function as short-term storage, the so-called linepack . By efficiently utilizing linepack, the natural gas system can provide flexibility to the power system through the flexible operation of gas-fired power plants. This requires accurately representing the gas flow physics governed by partial differential equations.

arxiv-2403-09852.title: Exploring Self-Gravitating Cylindrical Structures in Modified Gravity: Insights from Scalar-Vector-Tensor Theory
arxiv-2403-09852.creator: Davood Momeni, Phongpichit Channuie, Mudhahir Al-Ajmi
arxiv-2403-09852.description: Abstract We investigate static cylindrical solutions within an extended theory of modified gravity. By incorporating various coupling functions through a straightforward boost symmetry approach, we establish the equations of motion in a self-consistent manner and subsequently determine the linear scalar field profile.

arxiv-2501-13250.title: Generative Data Augmentation Challenge: Synthesis of Room Acoustics for Speaker Distance Estimation Thanks: This material is in part based on work supported by the National Science Foundation under grant numbers 2512987 and 1910940. The authors appreciate Michael Neri at Roma Tre University for the
arxiv-2501-13250.creator: Jackie Lin 1,7 , Georg Götz 2 , Hermes Sampedro Llopis 2 , Haukur Hafsteinsson 2 , Steinar Guðjónsson 2 , Daniel Gert Nielsen 2 , Finnur Pind 2 , Paris Smaragdis 1 , Dinesh Manocha 3 , John Hershey 4 , Trausti Kristjansson 5,6 , and Minje Kim 1,5,8
arxiv-2501-13250.description: Abstract This paper describes the synthesis of the room acoustics challenge as a part of the generative data augmentation workshop at ICASSP 2025. The challenge defines a unique generative task that is designed to improve the quantity and diversity of the room impulse responses dataset so that it can be used for spatially sensitive downstream tasks: speaker distance estimation.

arxiv-2503-01952.title: Universal Counterdiabatic Driving in Krylov Space
arxiv-2503-01952.creator: Stewart Morawetz, Anatoli Polkovnikov
arxiv-2503-01952.description: Abstract Local counterdiabatic (CD) driving provides a systematic way of constructing a control protocol to approximately suppress the excitations resulting from changing some parameter(s) of a quantum system at a finite rate. However, designing CD protocols typically requires knowledge of the original Hamiltonian a priori .

arxiv-2510-27567.title: Infrared singularities of multileg amplitudes with a massive particle at three loops
arxiv-2510-27567.creator: Einan Gardi, Zehao Zhu
arxiv-2510-27567.description: Abstract We determine the complete three-loop QCD soft anomalous dimension for multileg amplitudes involving a single massive coloured particle and any number of massless ones. This is achieved by applying a novel strategy based on a lightcone expansion of correlators of semi-infinite Wilson lines using the method of regions.

pmc-10648371.title: Four Markers Useful for the Distinction of Intrauterine Growth Restriction in Sheep
pmc-10648371.creator: Wannian Wang, Sijia Chen, Liying Qiao, Siying Zhang, Qiaoxia Liu, Kaijie Yang, Yangyang Pan, Jianhua Liu, Wenzhong Liu
pmc-10648371.description: Simple SummaryIntrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) is a disruption in the development of animal embryos or fetal organs in the maternal uterus and is highly regarded because of its serious detrimental effects on animal husbandry. However, there are few diagnostic methods and treatment options for IUGR, and its molecular mechanisms are not fully understood.

pmc-10652347.title: A single‐cell transcriptomic atlas characterizes age‐related changes of murine cranial stem cell niches
pmc-10652347.creator: Bo Li, Jingya Li, Bingzhi Li, Takehito Ouchi, Longjiang Li, Yu Li, Zhihe Zhao
pmc-10652347.description: The craniofacial bones provide structural support for the skull and accommodate the vulnerable brain tissue with a protective cavity. The bone tissue undergoes constant turnover, which relies on skeletal stem cells (SSCs) and/or mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) and their niches. SSCs/MSCs and their perivascular niche within the bone marrow are well characterized in long bones.

pmc-11470638.title: Potential impact of rotavirus vaccine introduction in India’s Universal Immunisation Programme on private sector vaccine utilisation: an interrupted time series analysis
pmc-11470638.creator: Habib Hasan Farooqui, Anup Karan, Aashna Mehta, Giridhara Rathnaiah Babu, Onno C. P. van Schayck
pmc-11470638.description: BackgroundDespite free immunisation services through the Universal Immunisation Programme (UIP), around 14% of Indian households seek immunisation in the private sector. We examined the potential impact of rotavirus vaccine (RVV) introduction in the Universal Immunisation Programme (UIP) on private-sector rotavirus vaccine utilisation.MethodsWe analysed nationally representative private-sector vaccine sales data.

pmc-11622846.title: Optimizing 5G network performance with dynamic resource allocation, robust encryption and Quality of Service (QoS) enhancement
pmc-11622846.creator: Abdullah M. Alashjaee, Sumit Kushwaha, Hayam Alamro, Asma Abbas Hassan, Fuhid Alanazi, Abdullah Mohamed
pmc-11622846.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The International Telecommunication Union (ITU) predicts a substantial and swift increase in global mobile data traffic. The predictions suggest that this growth will vary from 390 EB (exabytes) to 5,016 EB (exabytes) from 2024 to 2030, accordingly. This work presents a new maximum capacity model (MCM) to improve the dynamic resource allocation, robust encryption, and Quality of Service (QoS) in 5G networks which helps to meet the growing need for high-bandwidth applications such as Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) and video streaming.

pmc-12368206.title: Relationship between triglyceride and glucose related indexes and MAFLD in rural populations of northwest China
pmc-12368206.creator: Shipeng Gao, Xinyu Peng, Shijie Zhang, Jing Yang, Shuxia Guo, Yu Li, Rulin Ma, Yunhua Hu, Keerman Mulatibieke, Xianghui Zhang, Xinping Wang, Jia He, Heng Guo
pmc-12368206.description: Research has shown inconsistent links between triglyceride and glucose related indexes (TyG-related indexes) and metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) across various groups and areas. Our research focuses on exploring these connections to improve early identification and prevention of MAFLD among rural residents in Xinjiang, China. A total of 10,703 rural residents were included in this cohort study.

pmc-12515749.title: Metrics that matter: Identifying endpoints for capturing the broad health impacts of prevention of obesity
pmc-12515749.creator: Jonathan Pearson‐Stuttard, Sara Holloway, Jamie Kettle, Hugo Harper, Irina Pokhilenko, Manuel Gomes, Louis Garrison, Ricardo Reynoso, Katherine Byrne, Jutta Kloppenborg Heick Skau
pmc-12515749.description: AimsThe link between health and economic prosperity is well established, yet quantifying the value of illness prevention remains challenging due to lack of comprehensive metrics. Obesity exemplifies this issue, having widespread societal and health care impacts but limited prevention funding. Existing metrics often fail to capture broader effects of prevention of obesity.

pmc-12614444.title: Recurrent ovarian torsion challenges in management and saving fertility: A rare case report
pmc-12614444.creator: Hadeel Halabe, Maya Shahoud, Yaman Houari, Mahmoud Qasab, Dalaa Shahoud, Ashraf Olabi
pmc-12614444.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionOvarian torsion is a time-sensitive gynecologic emergency that may lead to irreversible ovarian damage. The condition becomes particularly critical in women with a solitary ovary, where timely diagnosis is essential to preserve fertility.Case presentationA woman of reproductive age with a history of right oophorectomy due to torsion of a mature cystic teratoma presented to the emergency department with acute lower abdominal pain, nausea, and vomiting.

pmc-12812923.title: Case report: Epidermolysis bullosa acquisita following dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitor therapy and complicated by immune thrombocytopenic purpura
pmc-12812923.creator: Hirofumi Kawamoto, Natsuko Sasaki, Yukimi Ueda, Norito Ishii, Yu Sawada
pmc-12812923.description: Epidermolysis bullosa acquisita (EBA) is a rare autoimmune blistering disease caused by autoantibodies to type VII collagen. While dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (DPP-4) inhibitors are established triggers for bullous pemphigoid (BP), their association with EBA has not been reported. A 68-year-old Japanese man with type 2 diabetes and chronic renal dysfunction, treated with linagliptin, developed widespread tense blisters with mucosal involvement.

pmc-13485777.creator: Ricardo Bezerra Costa, Monizy da Costa Silva, Emisael Stênio Batista Gomes, Rogério Gonçalves da Rocha, Stella Freitas de Queiroz Fragoso, Marta Angelo dos Santos, Ana Kelly da Silva Fernandes Duarte, André Luiz Sena Guimarães, Carlos Alberto de Carvalho Fraga, Francis Soares Gomes
pmc-13485777.description: BackgroundPlant lectins have attracted considerable interest because of their selective interactions with tumor-associated glycans and their potential antitumor properties. However, the effects of the lectin isolated from the bark of Genipa americana (GaBL) on different cancer cell models remain unknown.

pmc-13549378.title: Engineered nanomedicine remodels the postoperative cavity microenvironment to suppress glioblastoma recurrence
pmc-13549378.creator: Zhiqun Bai, Zhiguang Chen
pmc-13549378.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). uslaw-usc-t44-s1328.description: United States Code, Title 44 (Public Printing And Documents); Chapter 13 (Particular Reports And Documents). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Five thousand copies of the annual list of merchant vessels of the United States may be printed for distribution by the Coast Guard.

uslaw-usc-t49-s5501.title: 49 U.S.C. § 5501 — National Intermodal Transportation System policy
uslaw-usc-t49-s5501.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s5501.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Chapter 55 (Intermodal Transportation); Subchapter I (General). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) General.— It is the policy of the United States Government to develop a National Intermodal Transportation System that is economically efficient and environmentally sound, provides the foundation for the United States to compete in the global economy, and will move individuals and property.
